attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Nursing (RN); Louisiana State Board of Practical Nurse Examiners (LPN)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hours approved by any US board of nursing or accredited by ANCC (incl. ANCC-accredited approvers), LSBN-approved providers; related academic courses (1 semester hour = 15 contact hours)
rules.alternatives: Instead of 30 contact hours an RN may show 900 nursing practice hours in the 2-year period (employer-verified on a board form), or hold current national certification in a nursing specialty recognized by the board. Exemptions/extensions can be requested e.g. for active military duty, disability or enrollment in a refresher course.
rules.new_licensee_rule: RNs first licensed in Louisiana (by exam or endorsement) during the previous calendar year meet the requirement for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: At least 3% of renewing RNs are randomly audited each year (around March after renewal); documents must be mailed; keep CE records for 5 years.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal online Oct 1 - Dec 31; applications after Dec 31 pay a $50 late fee and unrenewed licenses expire Jan 31. The board does not state which year each license falls due. CE certificates must state ANCC or state-board accreditation.

rules.alternatives: No CE hours for renewal. Licensees or applicants out of practice for 4 or more years must complete a board-approved refresher course with at least 60 clinical hours.
rules.notes: LPNs are licensed by the separate LSBPNE (lsbpne.la.gov; lsbpne.com is no longer the board's site). Annual renewal via the Nurse Portal Nov 1 - Jan 31; rules set a $60 fee, the board quotes $61.08 total online. Unrenewed licenses become inactive-lapsed after Jan 31.
